items.title: Zutty Singleton and Marge Singleton Interview, 1969-02-08
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...you were really learning, Kelly, from Joneses. ... [INTERVIEWEE] And you were really learning piano from Jelly.

ctx.x: Play him at the parties and teach him to me.
They were all right. That's what made me stop taking this. Yeah, we need you. And you were really learning, Kelly, from Joneses. Because Frank would get it.
